Based on the provided text, several technical requirements are mentioned across different documents.  These include:

* **Context 1:**  A product inventory system using Django, PostgreSQL, and React.  Specific requirements include JWT authentication,  CRUD operations for products with validation rules (name length, price, stock quantity), case-insensitive name search, price/stock filtering, and CSV data export for admins.  Performance requirements specify handling 1000 concurrent users with under 2-second API response times.

* **Context 5:** An Employee Management System with potential frontend technologies (React.js/Angular), backend technologies (Node.js/Django/Flask), and databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL).  It also specifies JWT/OAuth 2.0 authentication and mentions requirements for security (secure login, encrypted data), scalability, availability (99.9% uptime), usability (intuitive UI with responsive design), and performance (fast CRUD operations under 1 second).  CSV/PDF report export is also required.

The other contexts describe testing requirements and not technical requirements for building the application.
